hero.title: Three tracks. *Year-round.*
hero.lede: A 77-acre Standardbred training facility in Aiken, run by a family with more than 70 years of racing and training experience between them.

sections.title: Built to *optimize your training*
sections.intro: All three tracks are groomed regularly and kept in tiptop shape. They have to be: we train our own Standardbred horses here, too.

items.title: One-mile red clay track
items.text: A full mile of red clay, groomed regularly.

items.title: Half-mile red clay track
items.text: A second red clay track for shorter work.

items.title: 7/8 mile sand track
items.text: Sand footing for a change of surface.

items.title: Over 250 stalls
items.text: With plenty of paddocks and ample barn space.

items.title: Living quarters on-site
items.text: For extended guests, and you can stay as long as you want.

items.title: A year-round climate
items.text: Average winter temperatures between 48 and 70 degrees, and about 36 inches of rain a year.

sections.title: We don't just *run the track*
body: We're a family owned and operated track and have more than 70 years of Standardbred racing and training experience between us.
We've dedicated our lives to making McGhees' Mile the most professional track in the business. We train our own horses here, so the tracks get the same care we'd want for ours.

sections.title: Planning your training season?
sections.text: Call to ask about stalls and living quarters.

before: No website of its own: a search leads to a social page or a directory listing
Hours, address and what you offer are spread across other people's sites
The first thing a new customer sees is not something the business controls
after: A site the business owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room to add a menu, photos and news as the owner supplies them
